title: Landscape efficiency frontiers for biodiversity, climate mitigation, and net economic value
abstract: Balancing biodiversity, climate and economic development means making difficult choices about how land is used. Stephen Polasky, Regents Professor and Fesler-Lampert Professor of Ecological/Environmental Economics at the University of Minnesota, explores the trade-offs between competing demands for land. Meeting biodiversity, climate, and economic development goals requires careful consideration of how to utilize land and the potential tradeoffs among different goals. Land used in one way, such as to grow crops to help meet food demand, cannot also be devoted to another use, such as maintaining natural habitat for biodiversity and increased carbon sequestration.
abstract_zh: 平衡生物多样性、气候与经济发展，意味着需要在土地利用方面做出艰难的选择。明尼苏达大学生态/环境经济学讲席教授（Regents Professor）、费斯勒-兰珀特讲座教授（Fesler-Lampert Professor）Stephen Polasky探讨了土地竞争性需求之间的权衡。实现生物多样性、气候和经济发展目标，需要审慎考虑如何利用土地，以及不同目标之间潜在的取舍。一块土地若用于种植作物以满足粮食需求，就不能同时用于维持生物多样性的自然栖息地或增加碳封存。

title: Nature-based tourism impacts on national GDP and local communities: insights from systematic and narrative literature review
Economic impact of nature-based tourism
Framework for Sustainable Recovery of Tourism in Protected Areas
abstract: Tourism in protected areas was a fast-growing segment within the global travel and tourism industry prior to the economic fallout from the COVID-19 pandemic. As a development pathway, tourism generated foreign exchange for countries endowed with natural assets (protected areas, pristine landscapes, forests, oceans, wildlife), contributed to conservation revenues, and provided local development benefits for communities. However, the spread of COVID-19 and its associated travel restrictions severely impacted this sector. In this review, we describe the main challenges preventing the sector from achieving its development potential. We propose a framework to steer tourism in protected areas as a green recovery initiative, so that it may rebound sustainably and continue to support biodiversity conservation and socio-economic development.
abstract_zh: 在新冠疫情造成经济冲击之前，保护区旅游是全球旅游和旅行业中增长迅速的细分领域。作为一种发展路径，旅游业为拥有自然资产（保护区、原始景观、森林、海洋、野生动物）的国家创造了外汇，为保护筹集了资金，并为社区带来了地方发展效益。然而，新冠疫情的蔓延及其伴随的旅行限制严重冲击了这一行业。在本综述中，我们描述了阻碍该行业实现发展潜力的主要挑战。我们提出了一个框架，以引导保护区旅游作为绿色复苏倡议，使其能够可持续地复苏，并继续支持生物多样性保护和社会经济发展。

title: Where Are the Gaps in Monitoring, Forecasting, and Managing Air Quality in Developing Countries? II Poster
No one knows which city has the highest concentration of fine particulate matter
abstract: Exposure to ambient fine particulate matter (PM2.5) is the leading global environmental risk factor for mortality and disease burden, with associated annual global welfare costs of trillions of dollars. Examined within is the ability of current data to answer a basic question about PM2.5, namely the location of the city with the highest PM2.5 concentration. The ability to answer this basic question serves as an indicator of scientific progress to assess global human exposure to air pollution and as an important component of efforts to reduce its impacts. Despite the importance of PM2.5, we find that insufficient monitoring data exist to answer this basic question about the spatial pattern of PM2.5 at the global scale. Only 24 of 234 countries have more than 3 monitors per million inhabitants, while density is an order of magnitude lower in the vast majority of the world's countries, with 141 having no regular PM2.5 monitoring at all. The global mean population distance to nearest PM2.5 monitor is 220 km, too large for exposure assessment. Efforts to fill in monitoring gaps with estimates from satellite remote sensing, chemical transport modeling, and statistical models have biases at individual monitor locations that can exceed 50 μg m−3. Progress in advancing knowledge about the global distribution of PM2.5 will require a harmonized network that integrates different types of monitoring equipment (regulatory networks, low-cost monitors, satellite remote sensing, and research-grade instrumentation) with atmospheric and statistical models. Realization of such an integrated framework will facilitate accurate identification of the location of the city with the highest PM2.5 concentration and play a key role in tracking the progress of efforts to reduce the global impacts of air pollution.
abstract_zh: 暴露于环境细颗粒物（PM2.5）是导致死亡和疾病负担的首要全球环境风险因素，其相关的全球年度福利成本高达数万亿美元。本文考察了现有数据能否回答关于PM2.5的一个基本问题，即PM2.5浓度最高的城市位于何处。能否回答这一基本问题，是评估全球人类空气污染暴露的科学进展的一项指标，也是减轻其影响工作的重要组成部分。尽管PM2.5十分重要，我们发现，现有监测数据不足以回答关于全球尺度上PM2.5空间格局的这一基本问题。在234个国家中，只有24个国家每百万居民拥有超过3个监测站，而在世界上绝大多数国家，监测密度要低一个数量级，其中141个国家根本没有常规的PM2.5监测。全球人口到最近PM2.5监测站的平均距离为220公里，对于暴露评估而言过大。利用卫星遥感、化学传输模型和统计模型的估计来填补监测空白，其在个别监测站位置上的偏差可能超过每立方米50微克。要推进对PM2.5全球分布的认识，需要建立一个统一的网络，将不同类型的监测设备（监管网络、低成本监测仪、卫星遥感以及研究级仪器）与大气模型和统计模型相结合。实现这一综合框架，将有助于准确识别PM2.5浓度最高城市的位置，并在追踪减轻空气污染全球影响的努力进展方面发挥关键作用。

title: Managing forest ecosystem services for hydropower production
abstract: In many countries, hydropower development is rapidly becoming a focus of green growth policies. This represents a significant opportunity for ecosystem services-based land management that integrates environmental and development goals to benefit the hydropower sector and support economic growth. In this study, we present an approach for targeting ecosystem-provision investment in hydropower catchments coupled with hydrologic modeling to quantify the benefits of soil and water conservation activities. We demonstrate the application of this approach in five hydropower facility catchments in the state of Himachal Pradesh, India. The results show that there is a high potential for targeted soil and water conservation to increase sediment retention services that benefit hydropower facilities (up to a 44% reduction in sediment transported from uplands into streams), although this benefit is distributed non-uniformly across catchments and levels of investment. The extent to which services can be improved is strongly driven by current land use and management practices that impact how and where conservation activities can be located. Iterative use of the method described here, in a process of stakeholder engagement and capacity-building, enables policy makers to determine the optimal mix of land management strategies and budget allocation to maximize service improvements that support hydropower production.
abstract_zh: 在许多国家，水电开发正迅速成为绿色增长政策的重点。这为基于生态系统服务的土地管理提供了重要机遇，这种管理将环境目标与发展目标相结合，以惠及水电行业并支持经济增长。在本研究中，我们提出了一种方法，用于确定水电流域中生态系统供给型投资的目标，并结合水文建模，量化水土保持活动的效益。我们在印度喜马偕尔邦的五个水电站流域中应用了这一方法。结果表明，有针对性的水土保持措施具有很大潜力，可增强惠及水电设施的泥沙滞留服务（使从高地流入溪流的泥沙最多减少44%），不过这一效益在不同流域和不同投资水平之间分布并不均匀。服务能够得到改善的程度，很大程度上取决于当前的土地利用和管理实践，这些实践影响着保护活动能够在何处、以何种方式开展。通过利益相关方参与和能力建设中反复运用本文所述的方法，政策制定者能够确定最优的土地管理策略组合和预算分配，以最大化支持水电生产的服务改善。

title: Does Disclosure Reduce Pollution? Evidence from India’s Green Rating Project
abstract: Public disclosure programs that collect and disseminate information about firms' environmental performance are increasingly popular in both developed and developing countries. Yet little is known about whether they actually improve environmental performance, particularly in the latter setting. We use detailed plant-level survey data to evaluate the impact of India's Green Rating Project (GRP) on the environmental performance of the country's largest pulp and paper plants. We find that the GRP drove significant reductions in pollution loadings among dirty plants but not among cleaner ones. This result comports with statistical and anecdotal evaluations of similar disclosure programs. We also find that plants located in wealthier communities were more responsive to GRP ratings, as were single-plant firms.
abstract_zh: 收集并传播企业环境绩效信息的公开披露计划，在发达国家和发展中国家都越来越受欢迎。然而，人们对其是否真正改善了环境绩效知之甚少，在发展中国家尤其如此。我们利用详细的工厂层面调查数据，评估了印度绿色评级计划（GRP）对该国最大的纸浆和造纸工厂环境绩效的影响。我们发现，GRP显著减少了高污染工厂的污染负荷，但对较清洁的工厂则没有此效果。这一结果与对类似披露计划的统计评估和轶事性评估相吻合。我们还发现，位于较富裕社区的工厂以及单一工厂企业对GRP评级的反应更为积极。

title: Estimating costs of adaptation to climate change
abstract: In 2009 the World Bank launched the Economics of Adaptation to Climate Change (EACC) study to provide up-to-date and consistent estimates of adaptation costs for developing countries. The EACC study addresses many of the shortcomings found in the adaptation cost literature. First, it defines ‘adaptation costs’ as those additional costs of development due to climate change, thereby avoiding confounding the costs of closing the development deficit and the implicit adaptation deficit. Second, the study covers eight major sectors: infrastructure, coastal zones, water supply, agriculture, fisheries, forests and ecosystems, human health, and extreme weather events. Third, it employs common population and GDP growth trajectories across sectors and uses two climate scenarios to capture the full spread of model predictions. Finally, the EACC study uses an innovative methodology for aggregating costs at the sector level within a country, and across countries. Under these assumptions, the global price tag for the developing world of adapting to an approximately 2°C warmer world by 2050 is US$70–100 billion per year for 2010–2050.
abstract_zh: 2009年，世界银行启动了“气候变化适应经济学”（EACC）研究，旨在为发展中国家提供最新且一致的适应成本估计。EACC研究解决了适应成本文献中存在的许多不足。首先，它将“适应成本”定义为由气候变化引起的额外发展成本，从而避免将弥补发展缺口的成本与隐含的适应缺口相混淆。其次，该研究涵盖八个主要部门：基础设施、沿海地区、供水、农业、渔业、森林和生态系统、人类健康以及极端天气事件。第三，它在各部门之间采用共同的人口和GDP增长轨迹，并使用两种气候情景来捕捉模型预测的全部分布范围。最后，EACC研究采用了一种创新的方法，用于在一国内部各部门之间以及跨国进行成本汇总。在这些假设条件下，发展中世界到2050年适应约2°C更温暖世界的全球成本为2010至2050年间每年700亿至1000亿美元。

title: The cost of fuel economy in the Indian passenger vehicle market
abstract: To investigate how fuel economy is valued in the Indian car market, we compute the cost to Indian consumers of purchasing a more fuel-efficient vehicle and compare it to the benefit of lower fuel costs over the life of the vehicle. We use hedonic price functions for four market segments (petrol hatchbacks, diesel hatchbacks, petrol sedans, and diesel sedans) to compute 95 percent confidence intervals for the marginal cost to the consumer of an increase in fuel economy. We find that the associated present value of fuel savings falls within the 95 percent confidence interval for some specifications, in all market segments, for the years 2002 through 2006.Thus, we fail to consistently reject the hypothesis that consumers appropriately value fuel economy. When we reject the null hypothesis, the marginal cost of additional fuel economy exceeds the present value of fuel savings, suggesting that consumers may, in fact, be overvaluing fuel economy.
abstract_zh: 为考察印度汽车市场如何评价燃油经济性，我们计算了印度消费者购买更省油车辆的成本，并将其与车辆使用寿命内较低燃料成本所带来的收益进行比较。我们利用四个细分市场（汽油两厢车、柴油两厢车、汽油三厢车和柴油三厢车）的享乐价格函数，计算消费者为提高燃油经济性而承担的边际成本的95%置信区间。我们发现，在2002年至2006年间，在所有细分市场中，对于部分设定而言，相关的燃油节省现值落在95%置信区间之内。因此，我们无法一致地拒绝消费者恰当地评价燃油经济性这一假设。当我们拒绝原假设时，额外燃油经济性的边际成本超过了燃油节省的现值，这表明消费者实际上可能高估了燃油经济性的价值。

title: The Costs to Developing Countries of Adapting to Climate Change. New Methods and Estimates.
The costs to developing countries of adapting to climate change : new methods and estimates - the global report of the economics of adaptation to climate change study
Poverty and the Environment: Exploring the Relationship Between Household Incomes, Private Assets, and Natural Assets
abstract: This paper develops an analytical framework to examine how rural households in developing countries derive income from common-pool natural resource stocks. The focus is on how three types of private assets—land, livestock, and human capital—and one household characteristic—its size—interact with the natural assets to form the basis of household livelihood strategies. Predictions of the model are tested using purpose-collected data from rural households in Jhabua, India. Implications of our results for the potential of improved natural resource management to alleviate poverty are discussed. (JEL Q12, Q21)
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析框架，用以考察发展中国家的农村家庭如何从公共池塘自然资源存量中获取收入。研究重点在于三类私人资产——土地、牲畜和人力资本——以及一个家庭特征——家庭规模——如何与自然资产相互作用，构成家庭生计策略的基础。该模型的预测使用从印度Jhabua农村家庭专门收集的数据进行了检验。本文还讨论了研究结果对于改善自然资源管理以缓解贫困的潜力的启示。（JEL分类号：Q12、Q21）

title: The Clean Development Mechanism’s Low-hanging Fruit Problem: When Might it Arise, and How Might it be Solved?
The irreversibility effect in environmental decisionmaking
The Impact of Delhi's CNG Program on Air Quality
abstract: This paper estimates the impact on Delhi's air quality of a number of policy measures recently implemented in the city to curb air pollution using monthly time-series data from 1990 to 2005. The best known of these measures is the court-mandated conversion of all commercial passenger vehicles - buses, three-wheelers, and taxis - to compressed natural gas (CNG). Broadly, the results point to the success of a number of policies implemented in Delhi but also to a number of areas of growing concern. For example, the results suggest that the conversion of buses from diesel to CNG has helped to reduce PM10, CO, and SO2 concentrations in the city and has not, contrary to conventional wisdom, led to the recent increase in NO2. At the same time, however, the conversion of three-wheelers from petrol to CNG has not had the same benefit, possibly because of poor technology. Another policy measure that appears to have had a positive impact on air quality is the reduction in the sulfur content of diesel and petrol. This has led to a decrease in SO2 levels and, because of conversion of SO2 to sulfates (a fine particle), a decrease in PM10 concentrations. Some of these gains from fuel switching and fuel-quality improvements are, however, being negated by the increase in the proportion of diesel-fueled cars, which is leading to an increase in PM10 and NO2 levels, and by the sheer increase in the number of vehicles.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1990年至2005年的月度时间序列数据，估算了德里近期为遏制空气污染而实施的若干政策措施对该市空气质量的影响。其中最著名的措施是法院强制要求将所有商用载客车辆——公共汽车、三轮车和出租车——改造为压缩天然气（CNG）车辆。总体而言，结果既表明德里实施的若干政策取得了成功，也揭示了若干令人日益担忧的领域。例如，结果表明，将公共汽车从柴油改为压缩天然气，有助于降低该市的PM10、一氧化碳和二氧化硫浓度，并且与一般看法相反，并未导致近期二氧化氮的上升。然而，与此同时，三轮车从汽油改为压缩天然气并未产生同样的效益，这可能是由于技术落后。另一项似乎对空气质量产生了积极影响的政策措施，是降低柴油和汽油的含硫量。这降低了二氧化硫的浓度，并且由于二氧化硫会转化为硫酸盐（一种细颗粒物），也降低了PM10的浓度。然而，燃料转换和燃料质量改善所带来的部分收益，正被柴油汽车比例的上升所抵消，这导致了PM10和二氧化氮水平的上升，同时车辆数量的绝对增长也在抵消这些收益。
